theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_pw_noi_smooth_cutoff_seq
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid n)), IsOpen V → ∃ b : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (b j)) ∧ (∀ j, HasCompactSupport (b j)) ∧ (∀ j, tsupport (b j) ⊆ V) ∧ (∀ j y, 0 ≤ b j y ∧ b j y ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ y, Tendsto (fun j => b j y) atTop (𝓝 (V.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
